$comment: Persons a eulogy only mentions, by current ID, added by extract_persons.py to data/persons.json after the eulogy's own with role "mentioned": {name, n?, where, marks: {la, it}}. where is the person's first printing. marks.la and marks.it are the person's printings in the Latin and Italian 2004 texts, in printed order, each {where, start, end, check}: "text" or {"footnote": n} (n from 1), offsets in UTF-16 code units into that text, and the check (the first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the printed words, which are never stored), as in data/mentions.json. marks.la is never empty; marks.it is [] when the Italian does not name the person (a missing list is an error). extract_mentions.py marks the person there and verifies each check. Written by scripts/mentioned_persons.py apply.
